# fixtures/simulator — provenance (GENERATED by scripts/export-fixtures.ts; do not edit)

The offline public-interface corpus of `acedward/mip-public-interfaces`: the PI set (`LSUNPI`, `SSTARPI`, `CNSTPI`, `UPROMPI`, spec 00024 §6.B) run step by step from `deployments/generated-matrix.json` in the Compact simulator, verifier keys installed as a deploy installs them. `events.json`: every `Misc` event in emission order (`mip-0018:token-metadata[v1]` `repository` declarations and `mip-xxxx:public-interface[v1]` pointer parts) and the Multi-Part Event packages they form — UPROMPI's pointer is the one 2-part package. `interfaces.json`: each contract's interface publication, its bundle (committed under `bundles/`), its circuits (verify-only = those taking a witness) and its final serialized state (the Level 2 input). Stand-ins: contract address `sha256("umbra:00024:<row>")`, one transaction per step `sha256("umbra:00024:sim:<row>:<step>")`, segment 1.

Regenerate: `node --import tsx scripts/export-fixtures.ts` — deterministic: two runs from the
same inputs give identical bytes (compare with the output hashes below). `test/fixtures.test.ts`
regenerates into a temporary directory and compares.
